Chapter 429: Chapter 6: The Tremor Of The Milky Way Star Region (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 429: Chapter 6: The Tremor of the Milky Way Star Region (Subscription Requested)

Although Lin Yuan was aware that “Shang Shan” wasn’t dead, he didn’t pay too much attention to it.

With Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed, he could crush “Shang Shan” now…

What about later on?

The one who should fear was the other party.

“Let’s take a look at the spoils of war.”

Lin Yuan placed the giant planet back onto the Star Dao. This planet, capable of being used as a nest by two Eighth Layer special life forms, was naturally extraordinary and was considered rare among high-tier life planets, enveloping tons of gentle cosmic energy.

...

When Lin Yuan struck at “Ao Du” and “Shang Shan,” he also did his best to avoid damaging the planet, restraining the aftermath to the planet’s surface.

“Special life blood essence…”

The first thing was the large amount of blood essences that Lin Yuan had collected.

Cosmic special life forms were rare, many of which were bred by the universe and incapable of reproduction. Their blood essences were far superior to humans.

Human civilization had, long ago, attempted to integrate these special life forms’ bloodlines into human bloodlines to get stronger offspring.

This gave birth to bloodline potions.

Through special means, extracting the blood of special life forms to produce bloodline potion essences.

These could be integrated into one’s own offspring’s bloodline, and for those Evolvers looking to establish a family, a single bloodline potion essence was enough to make the family prosper for long years.

“Speaking of which, I still have a Three-Headed Ice Wolf Blood Essence Potion…”

Lin Yuan seemed to recall something, a smile appearing on his face.

The Three-Headed Ice Wolf Blood Essence Potion was one of the legacies left by Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin.

Sourced from the special life Three-Headed Ice Wolf.

Back then, to create such a potion, Evolutionist Ou Yin had slaughtered countless Three-Headed Ice Wolves.

“I could probably make eight or nine bloodline potions… ”

Lin Yuan roughly calculated based on the blood left by “Shang Shan” and “Ao Du.”

These two special life forms were gigantic, almost comparable to ordinary life planets. Naturally, their blood was much more plentiful than that of the Three-Headed Ice Wolf.

Although the Three-Headed Ice Wolf was also a special life form, it was only dozens of meters in size, far less than “Shang Shan” and “Ao Du.”

“Eight or nine bloodline potions, even if one is only three thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, it adds up to nearly thirty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals…”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood.

Many human Eighth Layer Evolvers, with all their treasures and weapons combined, were only worth about ten thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Yet now, Lin Yuan’s gains, just from the blood essences, amounted to the entire fortunes of three Eighth Layer Evolvers.

This was still him possibly underestimating the bloodline potions; in reality, most bloodline potions were worth more than three thousand Cubic Universe Crystals each.

Next.

Lin Yuan began to explore the many treasures of the two special life forms.

“Really quite wealthy… No wonder they offered twenty thousand Universe Crystals…” Lin Yuan exclaimed in admiration.

The two special life forms “Shang Shan” and “Ao Du” had amassed a collection of many treasures, ores, weapons, etc., summing up to more than sixty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Among them, “Shang Shan” contributed more than forty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, and “Ao Du” contributed over twenty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Including the bloodline essences made from these two special life forms’ bloodlines, Lin Yuan’s income from this venture was estimated to be over one hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

“Never expected to recoup the Cosmic Crystals for the planetary transformation so quickly?”

A smile spread across Lin Yuan’s face.

The B-level transformation of the Milky Way Main Star had cost Lin Yuan one hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Lin Yuan initially thought that these hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals would only be earned back once the Milky Way Star Region was fully operational and trade channels were established.

But now, by merely cleaning up two special life forms, he had “broken even.”

“Continue.”

“There are a few more targets.”

Lin Yuan immediately headed in another direction.

After obtaining detailed information on the many special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers entrenched in the Milky Way Star Region,

Lin Yuan classified these special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers into two categories.

The first type was like “Shang Shan” and “Ao Du,” which fed on planets, leaving them was detrimental and useless to the Milky Way Star Region.

Thus, Lin Yuan’s approach to these special life forms was either to kill them directly, permanently eliminating future troubles, or to drive them out of the Milky Way Star Region.

The second type, which didn’t impact the Star Region and could form a “symbiotic” relationship with the Milky Way Star Region, included some special life form groups capable of producing treasures and rare items with incredible effects on human Evolvers.

As long as these special life form groups were compliant, Lin Yuan was willing to let them stay and even assigned protection for them.

The targets Lin Yuan was now rushing towards were the first type of special life forms and Alien Lone Walkers.

After tasting the sweetness of success, Lin Yuan knew he had to move as fast as possible, otherwise, once the news spread, those special life forms would probably have fled far away in fear.

…

Hum.

On a desolate planet,

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared, a massive shadow of world force suppressing the entire planet.

Two Alien Lone Walkers knelt down without hesitation, “Lord, spare our lives, Lord, spare our lives.”

Compared to “Shang Shan,” these two Alien Lone Walkers obviously lacked sufficient intelligence, not even recognizing the Galaxy Master.

Even if they didn’t know Lin Yuan’s identity, just the oppressive force of the world power made them feel like it was the end of the world, this man in blue armor markedly stronger than them…

Most likely a Peak Eighth Layer powerhouse.

“Sir, there must be some misunderstanding between us, I hope you can give us a chance…” The two Alien Lone Walkers pleaded extremely humbly.
